name: VAS native node: approved deployment to scan and Slack (local prototype)

parameters.jsCode: const r = $input.first().json; if (r.statusCode !== 200 || r.body?.ok !== true) throw new Error('Slack delivery was not confirmed. Check the Slack credential and channel, then retry only the notification step.'); return [{json:{notification:'sent'}}];

parameters.content:
## Native-node example — inactive
Requires the VAS community package; it is not published or n8n-verified yet.
1. Configure the fixed app, namespace and permission/terms on Create deployment scan.
2. Set project/environment, Slack channel and enabled in Configuration.
3. Bind webhook, VAS and Slack credentials in n8n.
No automatic create retries or replacement scans. Read errors stop polling with uncertainty. See examples/README.md in the public integration repository.
